title: How I Became The Real Snack CEO 🍟

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I can't believe the Principal is literally standing right in front of our secret midnight snack warehouse!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Nix, I told you that using the abandoned school basement for a [beat] distribution center was going to end in a total disaster!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: I was wondering why the entire football team was [beat] sneaking into the boiler room at 2 AM just to buy overpriced spicy chips!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: It's not just about the chips, Principal Huda, it's about providing a [beat] vital service to students who are too hungry to study!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: You cut into my territory, Nix, and I'm not letting a kid on a [beat] neon scooter take over the entire black market candy trade!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Hold your horses everyone, because Nix is not a criminal, he's actually my [beat] newest junior partner in my national vending startup!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: Wait, so the midnight scooter runs were just a [beat] beta test for Uncle Jamal's new delivery app that everyone is obsessed with?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I realized that if I could deliver chips to the school gym at midnight, I could [beat] deliver anything to anyone in this entire city.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: We used the scooter's GPS data to map out the most efficient [beat] routes, and now the tech giants are actually trying to buy us out!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Since you technically improved the school's [beat] logistics and donated the profits to the library, I suppose I can skip the detention.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: That's the thing about being the Snack CEO, you don't just [beat] satisfy a craving, you build a literal empire from the wheels up.

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: The Midnight Scooter is officially retired, but the [beat] Nix Snack Dynasty is just getting started on a global scale, baby!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The empire was built on crumbs, [beat] but Nix proved that even a midnight snack run can lead to a million-dollar business empire.
